sites.name: Delphi
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Archaeological site in Phocis; the sanctuary of Athena Pronaia, Kastalia spring area and Stadium were listed as closed for rockfall works.

access.opening: Winter (1 Nov to 31 Mar) 08:30 to 15:30, last admission 15:10; summer 08:00 to 20:00 with shorter hours from September.
access.tickets: Full €20 (about A$31.78 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), reduced €10. Pets not permitted (assistance dogs welcome).
access.permits: No permit stated; entry by ticket.

lore.text: Popular lore says the Pythia's prophecies came from vapours rising out of a chasm.
